About Elwood Robotics

Elwood Robotics builds the software that plans and checks warehouse robot fleets for grocery and parcel companies across the UK and Ireland. Our platform schedules 4,000 robots a night and our customers rely on it to ship on time.

What you'll do

  • Build and run Python services that plan robot routes across a warehouse floor
  • Design PostgreSQL schemas for telemetry that arrives at 20,000 events a second
  • Write tests in pytest and review your colleagues' pull requests every day
  • Work with operations engineers on site to understand what a failed pick costs
  • Own a service from the design document to the on-call rota, with support

What we're looking for

  • A degree in computer science, engineering or a related subject, or equivalent experience
  • Experience building REST APIs in Python, Go or a similar language
  • Comfort with SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
  • Clear written English: we decide most things in short design documents
  • The right to work in the UK (we are unable to sponsor visas for this role)

What we offer

  • A salary of £38,000 to £45,000 depending on experience
  • 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays
  • Hybrid working from our Manchester office two days a week
